page: OVHcloud b3-64 is a general-purpose virtual server built on the KVM hypervisor and powered by x86_64 AMD EPYC processors. It features 16 dedicated physical cores running at 2.3 GHz with a single thread per core configuration. The system is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Storage is provided locally via a 400 GB NVMe SSD, and network connectivity is supported by a 4 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results indicate strong memory performance, with both large-block read and write memory bandwidth (256MB) ranking in the top 25%. The PassMark memory score also falls into this strong category. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is strong, though multi-core stress-ng performance and PassMark CPU scores sit in the average tier. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and text generation for small (135M) LLM models also demonstrate strong performance, while database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput register average performance.

From a resource density perspective, the dedicated core allocation and bundled NVMe storage offer a highly predictable hardware profile without the resource contention typical of shared-core instances. The balanced 1:4 CPU-to-RAM ratio and local NVMe SSD make this instance well-suited for general-purpose workloads, medium-sized database deployments, web serving, and lightweight text generation tasks.
